subject: fix(schema): 按 git 存储的 LF 字节重算两条链的 codeSha256
message:
fix(schema): 按 git 存储的 LF 字节重算两条链的 codeSha256

合并后在主检出上复跑摘要门禁时 workflow-0009 报
"Recipe codeSha256 differs from gate.code_digest(root)"。真因：我的 worktree 里
workflow_automation_addition.py 与 _catalog.py 带 CRLF，而 core.autocrlf=input
使 git 存的是 LF（与既有 11 个 addition 模块一致）。摘要原先是按工作区的 CRLF
字节算的，与仓库里的真实字节不符。

修法是把工作区两个文件归一为 LF（与 main 上的字节逐字节一致，已核），再重跑
run-mandatory-checks.py 与 bind-recipes.py 重算。摘要全部现算不手抄：
workflow codeSha256 4c11c914…（= 主检出算出的值），sales154 1959cbba… 不变。

两条 recipe 摘要链 EXITCODE=0 且均 passed。控制器字节哈希未受影响（本次只动
两个 .py）。
reason: CRLF checkout 与 Git LF 存储字节不同，workflow recipe在合并后拒绝；提交正文明确报错与根因，diff仅重绑新执行材料

subject: fix(ci): qualify the batched-status controller and renew the Sales154 code digest
message:
fix(ci): qualify the batched-status controller and renew the Sales154 code digest

Two CI gates were red on main (cf019212), both from the same drift: three
integration_release_gate.CODE_FILES members changed after the Sales154 code
evidence was last renewed.

Gate 1, tests/maintenance-controller-qualification.test.mjs: 94312406 and
3cf4927f changed tools/django-local-service.ps1 without appending the new
hash to piNativeCandidateControllerSha256, so the controller bytes had no
reviewed qualification.

Reviewed the controller change rather than aligning the number. 94312406 adds
an opt-in cache of ONE Win32_Process enumeration (measured 8689 ms of ~20
per-PID CIM queries vs. 724 ms for one full enumeration), and 3cf4927f fixes
its first form, where @() inside each if-branch let PowerShell unwrap a
single-element array into a bare CimInstance whose .Count is $null, so every
single-row lookup reported false absence and DeployApp refused with a healthy
PostgreSQL on 5432. Verified the cache can never establish absence (consulted
only on attempt 1 and only when populated; a miss or blank-metadata row falls
through to the same live query and retry loop), that a failed enumeration
leaves it empty rather than absent-looking, that duplicate rows still trigger
the ambiguity throw, that Show-AggregateServiceStatus is the only populating
call site with an unconditional finally clear, that every lifecycle and
process-tree call site passes an explicit Attempts and never populates it, and
that Resolve-OwnedProcess forces -ReadOnly for any Status action. Nothing in
the stop/start protocol, maintenance, drain, receipts, migration logic or
permission boundaries is touched. Both PS5.1 and PS7 parse the file; the BOM
is retained.

Append the hash as a new reviewed export and keep all three older generations
registered so a rollback is not blocked by its own entry. Predecessor
djangoScriptSha256/workerScriptSha256 fields are untouched: they describe what
production currently has installed.

Keep the test tripwires' semantics: they still assert equality against exactly
one registered constant rather than following the file, and the new case covers
forward adoption, backward rollback, every older generation, unqualified bytes
failing closed, and no leakage to other controller names. Verified by appending
a byte to the .ps1 and confirming both suites fail.

Gate 2, tools/check_schema_code_digest.py: reported 7 errors, two more than
the controller drift alone (migrationSha256, and settings.py as a supplemental
binding, which 2c29fc3c changed).

Did not hand-edit the digests. The evidence file is an execution record, not a
hash table, so editing its numbers would fabricate a check that never ran.
Its generator is still in-tree and still matches its recorded
executionScriptSha256, and both prior renewals created a new task directory and
re-ran it. That generator can no longer run here: gate.source_delta refuses
because two unrelated workflow migrations (ed3bd8b3, 7ca4fbec) landed on main
and gate.common.migrations globs every app under backend/.

So the adapted generator changes only the migration-closure stage, and verifies
strictly more than before: every parent-153 migration is byte-identical, the
reviewed Sales154 step matches gate.FILES, the only other additions are the two
named workflow migrations pinned as literals (a third fails the script), and
source_delta's real refusal is recorded as a fact and asserted, not bypassed.
Django's migration graph still loads with sales.0012 carrying only AddIndex and
models matching migration state. The Sales154 generation delta is NOT
re-admitted and no addition module, catalogue, admission path or installed gate
is modified.

All digests computed, never transcribed. Note the ordering: the gate-1 fix
edits tools/manual-maintenance-continuation.mjs, which is itself a CODE_FILES
member, so it had to land before the gate-2 digests were computed.

Verified both CI commands against a clean git checkout-index export of the
staged bytes, reading exit codes from files rather than through a pipe:
gate 1 exits 0 (3/3), gate 2 exits 0 with "status": "passed" and no errors,
and tests/schema-code-digest-static.py passes 15/15. Worktree and staged blob
hashes match for all files, with .gitattributes entries added for the new
directory per existing precedent.

Baseline-compared against a detached worktree at cf019212 rather than inferring:
manual-maintenance-continuation had 1 pre-existing failure (this same drift),
not the ~7 estimated, and is now 50/50. The 3 failures in
manual-maintenance-business-readiness are pre-existing with byte-identical test
names and assertion messages on both sides, and are left alone.

Not merged, no artifact prepared, not released, production untouched.
gate.source_delta still refuses on main; that is a separate release-chain
blocker, recorded in the report and deliberately not worked around here.

Evidence and the full review: docs/ci-two-gates-fix-20261031/REPORT.md
reason: 后续controller修改未登记资格；同时CODE_FILES三项、migration及settings补充绑定漂移，报告基线失败与修后对照

subject: fix(watchdog): admit supervisor-stage drift and parse the installed source paths
message:
fix(watchdog): admit supervisor-stage drift and parse the installed source paths

Fixing pinned-source drift needs an install, but drift keeps health false.
The existing narrow exemption only recognised a control-stage failure, so a
candidate that repairs control leaves the failure at the supervisor stage and
the exemption became unreachable exactly when it was needed.

Admit the stage shape {control completed, supervisor failed} alongside the
original control-only shape, with exit code 1 as weak corroboration. The real
gate is unchanged: the caller must declare the drifted assets and the declared
set must equal the freshly recomputed one.

The recompute also hardcoded four source paths and assumed the deployed copy
for supervisor, while the installed driver hash-checks the repo tree. Parse the
paths back out of the installed driver's own literals instead, so a rename on
either side becomes a parse failure rather than a silently wrong drift set.
reason: 上一窄入口仅认control失败；新候选将失配移到supervisor，且旧重算用了错误源码路径；按已装driver路径核真实漂移

subject: fix(worker): keep package.json byte-exact for the release guard
message:
fix(worker): keep package.json byte-exact for the release guard

package.json is one of 11 guard-protected Worker entrypoints
(legacy-worker-guard-receipt.json, protectedSourceRoot = the main checkout).
worker-local-release-rotation.mjs:543 compares it byte-for-byte, so the npm
script entry added in b8c0ed58 made resolveEffectiveReleaseChain fail. Every
worker-local-service action then refused, including read-only Status, with
"Worker lifecycle result requires exact reconciliation".

The guard is only evaluated while resolving the chain, so the running Worker
was unaffected for 6.5 hours; it stopped at the 2026-10-31 08:06 reboot and
could not start again. Ports 3000/5791 were down for ~50 minutes.

Restore the file to its pre-b8c0ed58 bytes (hash c4c7f6a0... matches the
guard) and invoke the coverage gate directly in CI, which keeps the check
without touching a protected entrypoint.
reason: package.json新增npm script违反现役11个guard入口字节，重启后不能启动；还原原字节并直接从CI调用检查

subject: fix(watchdog): admit requalification when only pinned-source drift blocks install
message:
fix(watchdog): admit requalification when only pinned-source drift blocks install

operations-watchdog has been blind since 2026-10-18 (210 failures). Three of
the four pinned diagnostic sources drifted through normal merged development,
so Resolve-WatchStatusControl throws diagnostic_predecessor_changed, the
control probe stage fails, every later probe stays unprobed, and healthy can
never be true. Installing a regenerated driver is the fix, but the install
gate required health, so the fix could not be installed. All six historical
installs ran while healthy; the tool had no entry for recovering from this.

The gate still refuses by default. A new -RequalifyDriftedAssets parameter
admits exactly one narrow case: the operator declares the drifted asset names
and they must equal the actually drifted set, so this cannot serve as a
blanket "ignore health" switch. Also required: the evidence must be
pinned-source drift, control must be the only recorded stage and it must have
failed, and admission must be running.

Stages are recorded only as they run, so a later stage is absent rather than
failed once control fails. The predicate therefore requires control to be the
sole recorded stage instead of scanning for other failures, which would never
have seen an unprobed stage.

The running predecessor predates diagnosticBinding and reports only the
generic control-stage probe failure, so both evidence shapes are accepted.
When no asset list is reported, the drifted set is recomputed from
driver-binding.json and the same four sources Resolve-WatchStatusControl
compares, rather than trusting the caller's list.

Expected hashes are never updated automatically: the regenerated driver comes
from the prepared bundle, and no code path rewrites pins to match reality.
Every other admission check keeps its place and order, so all checks still
precede any production write.

tests/watchdog-install.test.ps1 18 -> 29 assertions, covering both evidence
shapes, the production path that self-recomputes drift, and set mismatches.
watchdog-diagnostics 42, operations-system-watchdog 36, all with
productionTouched false.
reason: 已装diagnostic driver四个source pin中的三个因正常开发漂移，无法健康又无法安装修复；增加有限重新资格入口

subject: fix: order Sales154 preservation rows by each table's real primary key
message:
fix: order Sales154 preservation rows by each table's real primary key

preservation() ordered all seven of153's tables by "id", but three key on a
OneToOne parent and have no such column (ai_pi_agents on session_id,
ai_pi_native_states on root_session_id, ai_pi_business_delegations on
intent_id), so PostgreSQL rejected the statement at prepare time and the
2026-10-30 release died in step 11 before writing install-intent.json.

Take the ordering column from pi_native_catalog.models_at_revision(), the
module's existing migration-state reader: the key feeds legacyRowsSha256 and
must match across the install/finalize pair, so it belongs pinned to the
reviewed bytes rather than to live catalogue state.

Add the layer's first tests, two of which run the statement against a real SQL
engine. Verified they fail on the pre-fix code; the chain's existing tests
inject fake cursors, which accept any column name and so could not catch this.

Renew codeSha256 and validationSha256, both computed, not transcribed.
reason: 修复preservation的真实主键排序，附带重签摘要是代码变更的必要交付；不把所有重签都当hash根因

subject: fix(boundary): refresh reviewed n8n metadata reader digest
message:
fix(boundary): refresh reviewed n8n metadata reader digest

Reviewed readN8nJackyunCloseEvidence: it reads only fixed workflow
execution_entity metadata through parameterized SELECTs. Callers supply
execution IDs, never SQL or database paths; no SQLite business-data
exception or arbitrary-path allowance is added.

The reader reuses the sole path-validated openN8nMetadata() and
DatabaseSync({ readOnly: true }); PRAGMA query_only=ON supplies a separate
SQL data-change guard. BEGIN provides a single read snapshot; the
connection-level read transaction intentionally ends in finally close,
which finalizes statements and rolls back the unended transaction rather
than committing it.

The complete emitted-JS graph retains only
tools/tmall-sycm-cookie-pipeline.ts as the reachable root for both the
reader and operator-close. Exact path, nonempty all-root and full-source
SHA enforcement, the exception list, and negative tests are unchanged.

message:
feat(release): 发布侧 apply 分项计时与第三代生产者资格

给 applyApprovedRotationPlanCore 的 15 个 await 点加纯日志分项计时，
定位「切换前端」那 202/213 秒的去向。复用第一步已导出的计时助手，
三个助手一字未改（SHA-256 与第一步钉死值逐字相同），只新增调用点。
键名统一加 apply. 前缀，三组重复调用以 #1/#2/#3 区分；两处条件分支
内的包装写在分支内部。调用参数、顺序与返回值结构均未改动。

生产者资格追加第三个闭包，前两个闭包字节原样保留在 closures[0]/[1]，
三代前向后向均可采用。profile 窄 flag preparationProducerQualifyOnly
沿用第一步所建，未新增、未放宽，verify-release-candidate.mjs 未改动。

同时修复 main 上的一个现存缺口：第一步的 comparePreparationTimingChange
是单代际设计，要求三个计时助手在 base 里不存在，故第一步合入后 base
变成含 S16 的一侧时该判定无条件判假——干净 main 配 base=origin/main
在 optimization-boundaries 这一步已经拿不到 passed。gen-2 改为两侧对称
strip、不再读取 base 的代际特征，助手判定改为两侧都须存在且文本逐字
相同，并要求候选真实新增包装点，使自比仍判假。

该用例另补一个语义早退：本次合入后 base 会追上候选、无增量可验，两条
正向断言届时会断言一个按设计为假的命题（比较器拒绝无新增的候选）。
早退按「包装点数 + strip 后语句集合均相同」判而非按字节，使仅改注释
或空行的情形同样命中；与上方用例既有的 if(unchanged)return 同性质。
早退只跳过那两条正向断言，全部否证用例在两种状态下都照跑，并新增一条
在任何 base 代际下都成立的断言 cmp(after,after)===false，把「自比判假」
从隐含性质变为显式断言。实测两个 base 均 4/4：合并前 b15bc095（有真实
增量）与模拟合并后 bfbd96df（base==候选）。

本步只加计时，不做任何削减；发布侧数据只能在真实发布时产生。

subject: feat(release): A 项合并前验证窄资格——Get-VerifiedProcessDescendants (#65)
message:
feat(release): A 项合并前验证窄资格——Get-VerifiedProcessDescendants (#65)

* fix(native): 停服务时按创建时间排除 PID 复用的假后裔

Windows 会回收 PID。父进程退出后它的号可能被别的程序占用，而那个
程序记录的 ParentProcessId 仍等于服务进程的号，于是被当作服务后裔。
2026-10-24 r3 发布因此中断约 26 分钟：PID 14720（360 readertray.exe，
进程元数据不可读）声称的父进程 11412 已被 reader 的 conhost 复用，
Django 控制器无法证明服务已停，报
"Process metadata is unavailable; absence is not established: 14720"。

Get-VerifiedProcessDescendants 增加两行守卫：枚举到的子进程若缺少
CreationDate，或其创建时间早于所声称父进程的创建时间，则跳过。真实
子进程必不早于父进程，早于即为 PID 复用造成的假亲子关系。

两处要点：
- 判据放在 Get-ProcessSnapshot 之前，并直接读 CIM 行的 CreationDate。
  该助手对空 CreationDate 会抛（:2594 的 metadataUnavailable 分支，以及
  Get-ProcessCreation 的 [datetime] 转换），正是本次要存活的场景。
- 两条守卫只会用 continue 把候选移出后裔集合，不新增候选、不扩大终止
  范围。:2645 的身份复核、Stop-VerifiedProcessTree 的根 PID 复用检查、
  维护进出、维护锁、排空、STARTED/SUCCESS 回执、worker 停止与信号处理
  均未改动，未新增外部进程。

措辞准确性（独立审查第 6 条，已采纳）：本次客观上放宽了阻断条件——
原先一个元数据不可读的 phantom 会让 Get-ProcessSnapshot 抛并阻断 Stop，
现在被静默跳过。这正是修复目标，但不宜表述为"未放宽任何断言"。
Stop-VerifiedProcessTree 自身字节未变，"改枚举不改终止"成立。

安全性依据（独立审查已独立追完并确认）：
- Stop-VerifiedProcessTree 的停止证明来自根进程（:2673 停根、:2676-2679
  复查，根没停掉即抛），后裔集合不参与"是否已停"的判定。
- 该函数对后裔本来就在用 continue 跳过（:2684、:2685-2688），本次与既有
  行为模式一致。
- 兜底是 Assert-ApplicationProcessesStopped（:2940）的端口与回执双判据
  （8001-8102 等 21 个端口，外加 8111/8112/8121，以及 14 组
  Resolve-OwnedProcess 与 Assert-DjangoSupervisorStopped）。审查追了
  Stop-OwnedProcess 的全部上游，确认没有任何调用路径会绕过端口复核就
  认定服务已停并继续部署。
- 第二个调用方：manual-maintenance-continuation.ps1:178/179/182 的
  Get-PiRemainingApplicationSnapshots 也用本函数，方向是更严不是更松——
  结果被当作 piAllowed 白名单，少一个条目只会让 :95 的
  $allowed.Count -ne 1 更容易抛，fail-closed。该观察器原先也会撞同一个
  "Process metadata is unavailable" 死局，本次顺带修好。
- 残余风险（记录备查）：若真有一个 CreationDate 读不到的真实后裔被跳过，
  Stop-OwnedProcess:2864 仍会删 PID 回执，它会变成无回执的游离进程；
  若它又不占门禁覆盖的端口，两道关都抓不到。实测 657 个活进程中
  CreationDate 为 null 的有 0 个（内核在创建时填入，不像映像路径那样
  受访问保护），故该路径近乎不可达。

CreationDate 语义实测（PowerShell 5.1，657 个活进程）：
- 时区无偏移：CIM 行是 Kind=Local 的 DateTime，ISO-8601 带 Z 的串经
  [datetime] 也落到 Local，同一进程往返比较 ticks 完全相等。
- 精度为亚毫秒级（645/657 行亚秒位非零，ticks mod 10000 有 456 个不同
  取值），足以区分同秒创建的真实父子。
- 用 -lt 而非 -le 是对的：-le 会误杀时间戳恰好相等的真实父子。全系统
  CreationDate 完全相同的父子对只有 System Idle Process(0) 自引用与
  System(4)->0，均不可能是服务后裔。
- 当前活进程中"子比所声称父更老"的 phantom 有 2 个（Secure System(236)、
  Registry(280)，均声称 ppid=4），证明该现象在生产机上实时存在。
- 对当前生产服务树的 195 组真实父子关系实测零误伤。

同步资格化（否则下次发布会被维护前驱检查拒绝）：
新增 aDescendantCreationGuardDjangoScriptSha256，与 PiNative 代际一并
登记在 piNativeCandidateControllerSha256 内，前后两代都可采用，使本次
改动的回退不被自身资格条目阻断。更新 continuation 测试的字节绊线，并
新增用例覆盖前向/后向采用、未资格化字节失败关闭、以及该哈希不泄漏到
其他控制器名。

已知的后继阻断点（本次发布路径不可达，记录备查）：
manual-maintenance-continuation.mjs:39 的
nativePiBusinessPredecessor.candidateDjangoScriptSha256 仍为 d884882a…，
而 :192 会断言 source 树 django-local-service.ps1 的字节等于它。该分支
要求 installedAi !== candidateAi 且 head.releaseId 命中 PiBusiness 的
20261019T130904Z-…；实测生产与仓库的 django-ai.ps1 字节相同
（f97cf7e2…）、当前 release 为 20261024T173320Z-…，两个条件都不满足，
走的是 :180 的 assertMaintenanceControllerGeneration（已资格化）。若将来
走到该路线，需一并为 candidateDjangoScriptSha256 资格化。

验证：process-identity 通过且仍识别到 2 个真实后裔（未误伤正常停止）；
fingerprint、rollback、native-ps5 通过；manual-maintenance-continuation
40/40、pi-readiness 25/25。business-readiness 13 个用例 10 通过 3 失败，
已在基线 525ad36b 实测为同名既有失败（django-ai.ps1 的 Pi 控制器资格），
与本次改动无关。

原生工具从包内冻结源码运行，按 S08 冻结规则随真实应用发布生效，
不单独触发准备。

* feat(release): A 项合并前验证窄资格——Get-VerifiedProcessDescendants

照搬 Q14 范式，为 django-local-service.ps1 的 Get-VerifiedProcessDescendants
（纯新增两行守卫，排除 PID 复用假后裔）新增 AST 级窄资格：

- descendantCreationGuardQualification：固定函数级新旧哈希，并与维护前准入
  已登记的整文件哈希（piNativeCandidateDjangoScriptSha256/
  aDescendantCreationGuardDjangoScriptSha256）双向绑定
- compareDescendantCreationGuardChange：证明仅该函数变化，函数数量/顺序、
  参数块、全部顶层语句逐字不变
- candidateCompatibilityProfile 新增 descendantCreationGuardOnly 标志，
  命中条件为变更文件恰为 django-local-service.ps1（可带两个资格载体）
- profile.django 分支新增该标志命中时改用 functionsOfExact（而非既有
  functionsOf）：该文件含中文注释，实测两者对此函数的提取文本不一致，
  仅在该分支切换，不影响其余 profile 的既有行为
- 新增 5 个真实字节测试（真实改动判真 + 5 项否证：方向颠倒、篡改其他
  函数、篡改顶层语句、守卫挪位置、函数数量变化）
- 发布限定资格文档登记一条
